text:
zoe_onboard: Oakridge Health returned their intake. Main asks: BYOK support for encryption at rest, attestation of key provenance, and whether embeddings/vector indexes can be restricted to EU-only. Procurement wants answers by Monday COB.

james_cs: Uploaded intake (oakridge_vendor_packet.pdf). They flagged PHI handling and want explicit wording that embeddings won't leave EU.

eli_se: Quick facts: BYOK is supported for Dedicated and Private deployments via customer KMS integrations (AWS/GCP). Hosted API uses Redwood-managed keys only.

nora_security: We can provide a short attestation paragraph for BYOK support and rotation cadence. We'll reference our SOC2 summary and the KMS integration guide.

infra_bot: Ticket created CS-4812 assigned to @nora_security. Due 2026-04-06.

eli_se: For region residency: Hosted requests may be routed cross-region; we cannot guarantee EU-only derivative storage on Hosted. To guarantee EU-only embeddings/indexes, customer must use a Dedicated or Private deployment provisioned in an EU region.

zoe_onboard: Can someone draft a 1-line answer + evidence link per ask: BYOK support (yes/no), Embeddings EU guarantee (yes/no + path), Attestation available (yes/no)? Legal needs a matrix.

james_cs: I'll assemble the matrix. Nora, can you drop the attestation paragraph here?

nora_security: Draft attestation: "Redwood supports customer-managed keys for Dedicated and Private deployments via AWS KMS and GCP KMS. Customers retain provenance and control over BYOK keys; Redwood rotates Redwood-managed keys in accordance with SOC2 controls. For evidence, see internal KMS guide and SOC2 summary."

eli_se: Sample Dedicated config snippet for customers (anonymized): ```yaml
deployment: dedicated
region: eu-central-1
encryption:
  provider: aws-kms
  kms_key_id: arn:aws:kms:eu-central-1:111222333:key/abcd1234
  mode: customer_managed
embeddings:
  persistence: true
  residency: eu-only
```

james_cs: Great. I'll create a 1-page PDF with matrix + attestation + config example and send to Oakridge procurement.

infra_bot: Reminder: CS-4812 due in 72 hours.

zoe_onboard: Thanks team. I'll include a note about hosted opt-in experimental flag for ephemeral embeddings (TTL=0) but that it requires ops approval and is not recommended for production PHI.

james_cs: Sending to Legal for review, will follow up once approved and then send to procurement. :thumbsup:
